memory_change_attribution.interpretation: Descriptive only. Six answers share the complete memory union. A changed question context can affect other answers. Changes with an identical full shared memory are reader/judge variation, not evidence of consolidation benefit. Exact XML differences can be metadata only; paired visible-source quote-set equality is also reported.

usage_scope: Entire pilot ledger, including development, holdout, repeats, failed calls and superseded prompt experiments.

runtime_revisions.cause: Orchestration-only CLI CODEX_MEM_DISABLED=1 override disabled candidate processing and retrieval briefs. This is infrastructure failure, not model rejection. NativeProcessorRunner already isolates its own app-server child.
runtime_revisions.revalidation: First saved baseline query had183chars; exact same Store with ordinary CLI environment returned4586chars. No bad-env reader is reused.
runtime_revisions.resolution: All17 calls have matched final reported usage. Driver terminated after current child finished. Remove CLI override and explicitly rerun fresh candidate clones and both arms readers; ledger and wall clock retained.

runtime_revisions.cause: Explicit prefreeze appositive reopening repair and reconsideration policy v3. Previous complete candidate primary preserved; baseline primary reader/judge state/context hashes verified unchanged and reused. No criteria/prompt/fixture changes.

limitations: Critical-error metrics grade answers and visible memory only. They are not an audit of every persisted merge. Neutral consolidation-audit.json bundles retain all accepted merge fields and fictional source evidence for separate human review.
Token cap is checked before each call; one final call can exceed it. Unreported usage remains unknown.
Primary arms share one live generated prefix. Two prescribed histories also regenerate the prefix independently; reader-only repeats are reported separately.
Fictional histories do not establish performance on private production histories.

cumulative_pilot_usage.scope: Previous completed pilot plus every native attempt in this iteration. Current iteration limits apply only to its own ledger.

coding_research_overhead_status: Unknown. Coding, research and orchestration model overhead is outside the measured native experiment ledgers.
